  ITEM 3:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-22-40, CONDITIONAL
  USE PERMIT CUP-22-17, AND LOT MERGER LOTM-22-03 (7:05
  P.M.)
  x 2834 West Main Street and APN 5292-008-002
  x Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit
  PD-22-40, Conditional Use Permit CUP-22-17, and Lot Merger
  LOTM-22-03 to construct a 733 square foot addition to an existing
  commercial building, reconfigure a parking area, and merge two (2)
  2
  08/07/2023
   parcels into one (1) parcel in order to accommodate a proposed
  nursery school in the CPD (Commercial Planned Development) zone.
  x  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-21 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-22-40, Conditional Use Permit CUP-22-17,
  and Lot Merger LOTM-22-03 subject to the Conditions of Approval,
  and finding Planned Development Permit PD-22-40, Conditional Use
  Permit CUP-22-17, and Lot Merger LOTM-22-03 to be exempt from
  review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Section 15301, Class 1 of Title 14 of the California Code
  of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects that are
  existing facilities, and pursuant to Section 15305, Class 5 of Title 14
  of the California Code of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA
  review projects that are minor alterations in land use limitations.
  x  Assistant Planner Kassandra Cornejo provided the Staff
  presentation.
  x  Ranum Magellan, the Applicant and business owner, was available
  to answer questions.
  x  The public hearing was opened and then closed.

  x  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  x  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  x Citywide

  22-01, for the readoption of the City of Alhambra’s 2021-2029
  General Plan Housing Element Update.
  x Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-19 recommending that
  the City Council adopt a Resolution approving General Plan
  Amendment GPA-22-01, to readopt the 2021-2029 Housing Element

  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) review is required for
  General Plan Amendment GPA-22-01 and the readoption of the 2021-
  2029 Housing Element of the City of Alhambra General Plan pursuant
  to Section 15162 of Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations.
  x Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso provided the Staff presentation.

G.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  x  Ron Sahu requested the Commission allow additional public comment during the
  continued public hearing for the Housing Element at the next regular meeting of the
  Planning Commission, including public comment from members of the public who
  provided comments during this evening’s meeting. (9:44 P.M.)

  x  Lewis McCammon commended Staff and the City’s consultant for their work on the
  Housing Element. Mr. McCammon discussed a meeting he had with a potential
  developer of the 801 East Main Street site and commented on the types of uses the
  community would like to see that will enable development of vibrant, walkable areas
  within the City. (9:46 P.M.)

  x  Bertha Rivera commented on being troubled with the City’s lack of concern for
  residents. Ms. Rivera discussed traffic issues at the Sprouts shopping center. (9:51
  P.M.)

  x  Meehar Tom requested the Commission allow additional public comment during the
  continued public hearing for the Housing Element at the next regular meeting
  especially if there is new information being provided. Ms. Tom commented on the
  Wondries Toyota development on Main Street and asked how the City allowed the
  development to be constructed so close to the property line of the adjacent residential
  property as well as the importance of allowing public review of development projects.
  (9:52 P.M.)
